title: Cumi DL569 Steerated Hook & Loop Disc Grit 400 Double Net Cut-off Orbital Sander 6 Hole using Angle Grinder 150mm (Beige, 25 Pcs)
description: HIGH CUTTING EFFICIENCY: The Hook & Loop Discs are designed with a central cut-out, removed from the traditional round discs, to reduce the chances of unexpected “marring” and deflection during operation, while increasing disc life and performance. These products are featured with a unique cutting edge and are engineered to cut with efficiency and ease. PROGRESSIVE RESIN SYSTEM: It is the perfect solution for the simple, quick recovery of your Cumi Lifting Disc. This replacement disc is made of steered resin to provide the stability needed for safe and successful lifts. Each disc is durable and lightweight to handle weights easily. HOOK AND LOOP BACKING: The round shape makes it the most common hook-and-loop fastener used in industries today. These self-adhesive fasteners are available in four configurations which include a standard bond, chip bond, high tack, and double-sided. LONG LASTING MATERIAL: The highest quality hook and loop discs are available. Perfect for a range of uses including mounting various accessories to your kit, these are sure to work well in a variety of applications. The material is strong and long-lasting; they'll help you get the job done without fail. WIDE APPLICATIONS: The Cumi Disc can be used on many applications. It is great for construction, carpentry, auto body repair project, automotive polishing, and home improvement projects, suitable for wood, metal, plastic, drywall, fiberglass porcelain, art, and craft as well as corner cleaning and polishing.
